div.head: Ps Cn for 33
div.ab: Quodsi casu inauspicato huiusmodi canes rabidi eueniant et ubique uagantes currunt negligentia dominorum, reddet eos illicitos, et emendentur regi pro illicitis.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 626 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
div.ab: But if by an ill-omened chance such dogs become rabid and run wandering everywhere through the negligence of their owners, it shall make them unlawful [?], and let compensation be paid to the king for them as for unlawful [dogs].

note.seg: Gegen Ausbreitung der Hundewut schreibt Papst Zacharias 751 Jaffé-Löw. Reg. pont. 2291; vgl. Cockayne Leechdoms III 388
